choices.why: The catalog has no mustard velvet sofa, so this rich teal tufted sofa stands in as a bold color anchor; mustard comes in through the cushions instead.
A honey rattan tub armchair with bamboo legs is exactly the bohemian rattan seat you asked for.
This oversized red mosaic wool rug has plenty of color and pattern and fills the large parquet floor.
Folk-print cushions with tassels in red, mustard, blue and green add cheerful color and pattern to the sofa and armchair.
Lush areca palms beside the balcony door and in the corners bring a lived-in, green feel; this piece only offers plants or pots on their own, so set them in your own ceramic pots.
This sunny yellow cube unit can lie on its side to make a low, cheerful bookcase under the window.
A carved whitewashed mango-wood drum table is round, crafted and bohemian.
A tall rice paper lantern lamp gives a soft, warm, relaxed glow.
A fringed jacquard throw in navy and tan with a global pattern layers nicely over the sofa armrest.

answer.why: A teal sofa, a red mosaic rug, a yellow bookcase and folk-print textiles mix with natural rattan, carved wood, rice paper and greenery to make a lively, eclectic bohemian living room in this bright, empty room.
